Question: A league with \(12\) teams holds a round-robin tournament, with each team playing every other team exactly once. Games either end with one team victorious or else end in a draw. A team scores \(2\) points for every game it wins and \(1\) point for every game it draws. Which of the following is not a true statement about the list of \(12\) scores?

Choices.A: There must be an even number of odd scores.
Choices.B: There must be an even number of even scores.
Choices.C: There cannot be two scores of \(0.\)
Choices.D: The sum of the scores must be at least \(100.\)
Choices.E: The highest score must be at least \(12.\)
